method: In-tree build script reproduces the deployed stripped curl executable and public FDPIC libcurl byte for byte; configure arguments, ELF layout and on-board transfers reviewed

details.configure_arguments: --host=arm-linux-uclibc --prefix=/usr --enable-shared --disable-static --enable-ipv6 --disable-threaded-resolver --with-mbedtls=<staged Mbed TLS> --with-default-ssl-backend=mbedtls --with-ca-bundle=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt; compression, HTTP/2, IDN, LDAP, SSH and the unused protocol backends are disabled
details.reproduction: The published script was run from a clean staged source tree twice; rootfs/usr/lib/libcurl.so.4.8.0 is 363524 bytes (sha256 4190f0a2...), rootfs/usr/bin/curl is 125836 bytes (sha256 09bb8967...), and both are stripped
details.size: Built with -Os, section GC and -z noseparate-code. curl has a 114692-byte largest PT_LOAD; public libcurl has a 346176-byte largest PT_LOAD. Both fit an order-7 (512 KiB) buddy block, while keeping text and .rodata together so the FDPIC compiler's default PC-relative read-only-data addressing remains valid on the no-MMU loader.
details.linked_libraries: curl NEEDs libcurl.so.4, libmbedtls.so.21, libmbedx509.so.7, libmbedcrypto.so.16 and libc.so.0; libcurl has SONAME libcurl.so.4 and NEEDs the three Mbed TLS libraries plus libc.so.0. All are FDPIC shared objects and neither output has TEXTREL.
details.features: HTTPS-proxy IPv6 Largefile SSL threadsafe UnixSockets
details.on_board: Verified on the N32H787 board with libcurl staged outside the old rootfs: 20 consecutive curl --version calls reported curl/libcurl 8.23.0 and mbedTLS/3.6.7; HTTP and HTTPS example.com returned 200, and four simultaneous HTTP/HTTPS transfers all completed. The dynamic WeniClaw build also fetched example.com through the same libcurl.so.4.
details.licenses: curl license (MIT/X derivative); COPYING preserved in licenses/curl/COPYING and installed in the rootfs
details.xattr: Rebuilt after the toolchain sysroot restored the xattr interface (UCLIBC_HAS_XATTR): the binary now carries curl's fsetxattr path. On the board, --xattr on a filesystem without xattr support prints "Operation not supported", still saves the file and exits 0.
